params.caption: 🎮 Rockstar tribunal over 34 fired workers ends — verdict still to come The Glasgow employment tribunal over the 34 staff Rockstar dismissed in 2025 has wrapped up, with a judgement expected in a few weeks to a few months. The IWGB union calls the firings union busting; Rockstar says the workers leaked confidential information. Eurogamer confirms at least 28 of the 34 are still named in the GTA 6 credits, and the workers have asked fans not to boycott the game. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 20:35 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Eurogamer · VGC 👥 @RockstarGames ⚖️ Which way do you think the verdict goes? React and drop your take 💬 #GTA6 #Rockstar #IWGB #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
